import qiskit_aer
import qiskit_ibm_runtime

code:
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService

QiskitRuntimeService.save_account(
    channel="ibm_quantum_platform",
    token="YOUR_API_TOKEN",
    overwrite=True,
)
caption: Verify the channel name and token flow against IBM's current docs — this has changed more than once as the platform evolved.
